start.description:
Start timestamp for the muted period.
If null, defaults to now.

end.description: End timestamp for the muted period.

parent.description: The primary {@link ReliabilityAsset} for this muted period.

targets.description:
The target entities to mute alerts for. Must be one of the following {@link Persistable} types.
- {@link ReliabilityMlModel} - champion models only. If specified, {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}s from these models
                               will be muted.
- {@link Sensor} - If specified, {@link SensorHealthAlert}s for these sensors will be muted.

action.description:
The action to perform: either 'MUTE' or 'UNMUTE' alerts for the specified #targets.
When unmuting, any active muted periods for the specified #targets will be ended immediately by setting their
end time to now. {@link AlertMutedPeriod}s are not deleted to preserve historical data.

title:
Specification type for creating {@link AlertMutedPeriod}s.
This type holds all the fields applicable for muting alerts.
name: AlertMutedPeriodSpec
